## Details

<a id="animate_fighters"></a>
### [`animate_fighters`](../../../../src/fighter/animate.asm#L6) `$87CE`

*routine*

Animates both fighters and draws them into the work bitmap. The drawing order sets which fighter is in front. When fighter 1 does one of the 4 moves at $bc0f, fighter 0 goes first. During set-up ($ba bit 7) it does nothing. When $bb bit 7 is set, it animates only fighter 0.

- **Called from:** [`$80D3`](../../../../src/main/main_loop.asm#L15)

<a id="animate_fighter"></a>
### [`animate_fighter`](../../../../src/fighter/animate.asm#L32) `$87F7`

*routine*

Steps the move sequence of fighter X by one byte and draws the new pose. The sequence of move $67,x comes from the pointers at $bb1d. A byte below $ff is a pose number. $ff is a command. The next byte: 0 = start again, 1 = write $01 to fighter_move (bit 7 clear) and return, 2 = go to an index. Command 3 starts the next move. A higher command holds the last pose. At move $9d (turn), command 3 also changes the facing and moves the fighter by $7f4a.

- **Called from:** [`animate_fighters`](animate.md#animate_fighters)
- **Jumped to from:** [`animate_fighters`](animate.md#animate_fighters)
- **Calls:** [`clear_pose_buffer`](pose_image.md#clear_pose_buffer), [`move_fighter`](move.md#move_fighter), [`build_pose_image`](pose_image.md#build_pose_image), [`draw_fighter`](draw.md#draw_fighter)
